code_examples.section: ltm rule event PING REQUEST READY
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PING_REQUEST_READY
       Triggered when TMM has assembled an HTTP request to PingAccess policy server

DESCRIPTION
       This event is triggered to execute HTTP commands before the request to ping access server is released.

Examples
	when PING_REQUEST_READY {
	    HTTP::header insert header_1 value_1
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
